jobs.title: SG Fleet Internship Program 2026 – AI Stream
jobs.description: As an AI Intern, you'll work across SG Fleet's technical and commercial teams to develop GenAI prototypes, automate business processes, and support data-driven decision-making. You'll also have the unique opportunity to collaborate closely with SG Fleet's Chief Operating Officer (COO) on strategic initiatives that shape the future of AI within the business. This internship offers exposure to prompt engineering, large language model optimisation, and the research of emerging GenAI technologies.

jobs.title: SG Fleet Internship Program 2026 – Data & Analytics Stream
jobs.description: As a Data & Analytics Intern, you'll join SG Fleet's enterprise data team to help design and build data pipelines, analytical models, and reporting solutions. You'll gain hands-on experience with modern platforms like Databricks and Microsoft Azure, and contribute to SG Fleet's data lakehouse architecture. This internship offers exposure to real-world data engineering, stakeholder collaboration, and the development of AI and ML initiatives that enhance customer and business experiences.

jobs.title: Graduate Data Scientist / Data Engineer
jobs.description: As a Graduate Data Scientist or Graduate Data Engineer, you'll join a collaborative analytics and data delivery team supporting mission-critical programs for our customers. You'll work on meaningful projects that turn data into insights, insights into action, and engineering into robust, secure data solutions. Depending on your background and interests, you may focus on analytics, data modelling or data engineering—or build experience across all three as part of your early career development.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst

The position involves working in a dynamic and fast paced environment, with exposure to the commercial aspect of both Australia & New Zealand with opportunities to add value within Asia markets in the near future.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: You will bring state-of-the-art machine learning models from ideas into production. The role involves taking ownership of complex projects and delivering well-structured, well-tested, production-ready solutions, and taking a leading role in designing and building innovative machine learning and other algorithmic solutions, API services and data pipelines.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: The position requires expertise in manipulating, processing, and extracting value from large, disconnected datasets; expertise with SQL, relational databases, semi-structured data stores, NoSQL, and graph databases; and strong programming skills with at least one language such as Python, R, Scala, Java or other. Commercial experience building, optimising, and automating big data pipelines on cloud platforms, preferably AWS, using Spark, Glue, or similar.

jobs.title: Intern – Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Machine Learning Engineers design and build the infrastructure and services that power AI products that serve millions of customers every day, and work closely with Applied Scientists through the research and development process to create harnesses and interfaces to safely take models from research to production environments. As a machine learning intern, you'll design and build infrastructure for AI products, create and test software, resolve issues, and contribute to continuous improvement using engineering standards and frameworks.

jobs.title: Data Science Internship

You are required to work across multiple teams and functions for developing cutting edge, creative and advanced analytic solutions and processes.
